posts.title: 12 new animals in the packs
posts.text: The Cat Pack has 8 more cats: wild ones like the ocelot, bobcat and Pallas's cat, and breeds like the Siamese, Ragdoll, Maine Coon, Bengal and Sphynx. The Backyard Pack adds a coati, a red squirrel, a palm squirrel and a prairie dog. Try them all in the Fitting Room.

posts.title: Dress up in the Play park
posts.text: Tap 👕 in the Play park to open the Fitting Room without leaving. Change a look or a hat, or bring in another pet, and they keep it on while they play. With a pack, you pick Keep or Put it back when you leave, for what your packs cover.

posts.title: 19 new hats
posts.text: Nineteen new hats for your pets: a wizard hat, a halo, a propeller beanie and more, plus hats from around the world like a fez, a nón lá, a kalpak, a chullo and a Panama hat. They come with any pack; pick one in the Fitting Room.

posts.title: Search help
posts.text: Help has a search box now: type a few words and the answers show up as you type. Below it are the Most asked questions and a tile for each topic. Want the intro again? It has its own card near the bottom.

posts.title: Squirrel, chipmunk and groundhog
posts.text: Three new visitors in the Backyard Pack, each moving like the real animal: the squirrel dashes about, sits up with a nut and comes down the side of your screen head-first; the chipmunk stuffs its cheeks; the groundhog waddles, stands up tall to look around and digs. If you had the Cat Pack before the Backyard Pack came, they're yours too.
